text:
Jordan (Product): Hey team — quick copy review for the Workspace deletion modal. Current text: 'Delete workspace? This cannot be undone.' feels terse and maybe not clear about scope of data loss.
Priya (Design): +1. Feels alarmist but vague. We should call out what is removed (projects, settings, audit logs?) and whether org-level links are affected.
Ethan (Frontend): Are we also planning an undo? Right now the flow is destructive immediately after confirm.
Jordan (Product): Proposal: change modal body to: 'Permanently delete this workspace and all associated projects, API keys, and logs. This action cannot be undone.' And after deletion show a toast: 'Workspace deleted — Undo' available for 30s.
Priya (Design): Sounds clearer. I prefer: Title = 'Permanently delete workspace' CTA = red 'Delete workspace' Secondary = 'Cancel' Body = your proposed sentence + small helper line: 'You’ll have 30 seconds to undo.'
Marta (Accessibility): A couple accessibility nits: 1) Modal needs role=dialog and focus trap. 2) The toast undo must announce via aria-live so screen readers hear "Workspace deleted. Undo available." 3) Avoid using only 'This action cannot be undone' as the only context — say what is deleted.
Ethan (Frontend): Implementation questions: toast should be aria-live="polite" or "assertive"? If it's assertive it might interrupt. For destructive actions maybe assertive is better.
Marta (Accessibility): Use assertive for the initial delete announcement, but ensure it's short. The undo button should be keyboard-focusable and included in the a11y text: e.g. aria-label="Undo delete workspace".
Priya (Design): Microcopy tweak: Instead of 'You’ll have 30 seconds to undo.' maybe 'You have 30 seconds to undo this action.' Slightly more direct.
Jordan (Product): Also want to confirm audit logging: ops-bot will create an event with actor + timestamp. ops-bot can post to #audits. Do we want to mention audit logs in the modal copy? Might be heavy.
Marta (Accessibility): Only mention audit logs if it helps users. Might confuse others. Zero or one-line: 'This action is recorded in audit logs.' could be fine but maybe buried in advanced info.
Ethan (Frontend): For keyboard shortcuts: pressing Esc should close modal, Enter on primary confirms — do we want an extra confirmation pattern like typing workspace name? For risky org-level deletes we do that, but for workspace we currently don't. Product decision?
Jordan (Product): For now keep it a single confirm + undo toast. If customers request stronger safeguards we can add confirm-typing later for org admins.
Priya (Design): Tiny copy nit for CTA: use sentence case 'Delete workspace' rather than ALL CAPS. Also consider changing helper copy color to muted gray to de-emphasize.
Ethan (Frontend): I'll implement: modal copy change, role/focus trap, confirm button text, and the toast with 30s undo. Toast will set aria-live="assertive" and have an "Undo" button with aria-label.
Marta (Accessibility): Add a screen-reader only region that reads the exact resources deleted: "This will delete: 3 projects, 7 API keys, logs." If we can compute counts that's great; otherwise use pluralizable items: 'associated projects, API keys, and logs.'
ops-bot: Audit: workspace.delete event will be logged to audits service with actor=jordan, ts=2301112223.
Priya (Design): I'll update Figma copy and include the muted helper line and focus order notes.
Jordan (Product): Decision: change copy to Jordans' proposed line + 'You have 30 seconds to undo this action.' Add the toast undo. No typing confirmation for now. Action items below.
Ethan (Frontend): ACTION: PR with modal + toast + a11y labels by end of sprint.
Priya (Design): ACTION: Update Figma and handoff copy tokens.
Marta (Accessibility): ACTION: Add automated screen reader test case and checklist entry for aria-live and undo button focus.
Jordan (Product): Thanks. @Priya please add final approved string to the PR description so translations team sees it.
Priya (Design): Will do. :white_check_mark:
Ethan (Frontend): quick question: should the toast show a small link 'View workspace' in case they deleted the wrong one and want to inspect? That could re-open a 404.
Jordan (Product): Nah, keep toast minimal. Undo is primary. If they re-open via nav that's ok.
Marta (Accessibility): One last nit: ensure the modal's close icon has aria-label="Close dialog" and that keyboard focus returns to the original trigger after close/undo.
Priya (Design): Ack.
Jordan (Product): Great thread — moving to implement. I'll follow up if we need confirm-typing later.
